Reid Firetrail 1 Flatbar | Gravel bike
Versatile, comfortable and ready for adventure – the ideal entry-level gravel bike from Reid Bikes is built for exploring off-road trails, navigating city streets or adding some variety to your everyday commute.
The Reid Bikes Firetrail 1 Flatbar gravel bike is designed to combine the versatility of a gravel bike with the comfortable, upright riding position of flat handlebars. Built for riders who want to explore beyond the tarmac without compromising on everyday practicality, it's a capable all-rounder for gravel paths, cycle routes, urban journeys and weekend adventures.
At its core is a lightweight 6061 aluminium frame, featuring a tapered head tube and internal cable routing for a clean finish and responsive handling. Paired with an alloy disc fork and 12mm front thru-axle, the Firetrail 1 Flatbar delivers stability and control across a variety of surfaces. Practical luggage mounts and generous tyre clearance also make it easy to adapt the bike for commuting, longer rides or bikepacking adventures.
A 16-speed LTWOO drivetrain provides a versatile range of gearing for tackling climbs, covering flat stretches and navigating changing terrain. The Prowheel compact alloy chainset, paired with an 11-32T cassette, offers reliable gear selection for both road and off-road riding. Tektro mechanical disc brakes with 160mm rotors provide dependable stopping power and controlled braking in a range of weather conditions.
The Reid Bikes Firetrail 1 Flatbar comes equipped with 700x45c Kenda gravel tyres, offering a balance of grip, comfort and rolling efficiency across gravel tracks, cycle paths and paved roads. The wide 700mm alloy handlebars with a 15mm rise provide a comfortable, controlled riding position, while the 80mm alloy stem and MTB-style grips add to the bike's practical, everyday setup. A Reid sport saddle completes the package, providing support for everything from shorter commutes to longer weekend rides.
With its lightweight aluminium frame, versatile gearing, flat handlebar design and practical luggage mounts, the Reid Firetrail 1 Flatbar is built to handle more than one type of ride. From everyday cycling and urban commuting to gravel exploration and bikepacking, it's a versatile and affordable introduction to gravel cycling.
The Reid Bikes Firetrail 1 Flatbar is ideal for:

Gravel riding and off-road exploration, with 700x45c Kenda tyres offering grip and comfort across mixed terrain

Everyday commuting, with a comfortable flat handlebar setup and practical mounts for accessories

Urban cycling and cycle paths, with responsive handling and tyres that balance grip with efficient rolling

Bikepacking and longer adventures, with luggage mounts for carrying essential equipment

Riders looking for a comfortable riding position, with 700mm wide riser handlebars and MTB-style grips

Tackling hills and varied routes, with a 16-speed LTWOO drivetrain and 11-32T cassette

Reliable all-weather braking, with Tektro mechanical disc brakes and 160mm rotors

Stable and controlled handling, with a lightweight 6061 aluminium frame, alloy fork and 12mm front thru-axle

Riders looking for an entry-level gravel bike, combining practical features, versatile performance and excellent value for everyday riding and weekend adventures
